scale.0: Absent, fundamentally incorrect, or breaks the required flow.
scale.1: Partial scaffolding or happy-path fragments with major gaps.
scale.2: Substantial working behavior with material integration or failure-path gaps.
scale.3: Complete core flow with only limited, evidenced robustness or regression gaps.
scale.4: Complete, integrated, and supported by convincing evidence for the stated scenarios.

scoring: sum(weight * level / 4), computed by the orchestrator; code similarity is not a criterion

criteria.title: Portal catalog and versioned editor
criteria.scenarios: Navigate from prompt list to editor; switch versions without mixing state; friendly names, published badges, routing and API mocks remain consistent.

criteria.title: Immutable published versions and draft editing
criteria.scenarios: Save unpublished content in place or as a new version; attempt direct mutation of deployed content; republish an older version without modifying its stored content.

criteria.title: Token validation and conditional rendering
criteria.scenarios: Known required tokens, unknown tokens, multiline conditional blocks, constants versus JSON keys, and malformed token boundaries; ensure frontend and server agree.

criteria.title: Shared prompt identity and dependencies
criteria.scenarios: Two primary types share a token; fetch and deploy the shared prompt; inspect affected-type reporting and identity/partition separation; missing shared data must not resolve as a primary prompt.

criteria.title: Publish, rollback and runtime storage consistency
criteria.scenarios: Publish a draft and then roll back; read through runtime storage and DB fallback; inspect write ordering and partial failure behavior rather than assuming an impossible cross-store transaction.

criteria.title: Authenticated cross-environment fetching and version overrides
criteria.scenarios: Published default and explicit older version in separate calls; nonproduction eager and lazy requests; authorization and unavailable production endpoint; no global override leakage.

criteria.title: Script-aware eager loading and safe lazy caching
criteria.scenarios: Different scripts and concurrent calls need different prompt subsets; shared dependencies, lazy cache misses, missing rows, cancellation and EF context lifetime; inspect both correctness and redundant calls.

criteria.title: Managed source of truth and initialization
criteria.scenarios: Existing prompt catalog can be initialized; restarting locally does not silently replace managed versions; test/development overrides work with mocked clients; no paid prompt suite execution.

criteria.title: Integration with bot and testing execution paths
criteria.scenarios: Trace LiveKit, Twilio and text/test initialization through prompt generation; detect implemented services that are never registered or invoked.

criteria.title: Constants editing and type duplication
criteria.scenarios: Create/update/remove a constant and duplicate a type with token associations; reject invalid/conflicting input; maintain shared versus primary contracts.

criteria.title: Authorization, tenancy and additive schema integration
criteria.scenarios: Inspect migrations, null handling for existing records, scoped services and controller authorization; do not require later unrelated schema or framework changes.

criteria.title: Meaningful automated coverage and maintainability
criteria.scenarios: Tests exercise failure paths and behavior across APIs/runtime/UI; distinguish actually executed checks from claims and unavailable infrastructure.
